page.overview:
Who is Jantō?

Jantō is an experienced and calculating gambler who likes games with good odds.

Jantō has short spiky light brown hair and black-coloured eyes. He also wears a pair of glasses. He wears a black kimono with white rimmings.

He is behind the times, as he had never heard of Tsunade's notoriously bad luck when Jiraiya and Naruto come to ask him about her.

Jantō appears in Naruto Mobile as a constant rival for the player in the Tanzaku location. He fights with cards, throwing them at the opponent.
